required_consumer_invariants: Resolve ownership from the authenticated transport; client intent never supplies principal, agent or credentials
Retry the exact command/idempotency key after disconnect; changed intent must use a new key
Accepted command receipts are not completion, effect confirmation or delivery acknowledgment
On snapshot_required replace the projection with the returned snapshot and resume from its cursor
Cancel is a command; a transport timeout never ends or restarts a mission
Artifact versions and byte digests are immutable; current heads use expected-version CAS
Approval binds exact content, target, owner generation and live authority; stale or revoked approvals fail closed
Delivery retry never reexecutes the mission; missing artifact acknowledgment is partial delivery
Keep one runtime owner and one scheduler per mission; Dots remains a later transport/projection consumer
